notes: Company: MossGrove builds a B2B SaaS knowledge assistant for onboarding & support (mid-market customers).
Primary eval flow: start with Hosted API for quick integration, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost control if POC successful.
POC dataset: ~5M short docs (kb articles + transcripts); nightly batch re-index expected; initial ingest batch ~200k docs/day.
Performance targets: 95th p99 retrieval latency < 120ms for embedding lookup; UI top-3 relevance ideally sub-50ms; throughput target ~400-600 QPS for embeddings + top-k retrieval during peak.
Batch jobs: nightly re-embedding and re-indexing window 2–4AM PST; want to offload heavy quant/transform to Dedicated nodes to avoid API throttling.
Vector DB integration: testing Pinecone and Weaviate in POC; prefer managed vector store but must confirm write throughput and shard behavior for 5M vectors.
Model preferences: open embeddings initially (better cost control), evaluated 1536-d & 3072-d vectors; interested in Redwood model catalog recommendations and quantized variants.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market constraints; willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit cost reductions >25% vs hosted on-demand.
Security: requires SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for key management, audit log export for compliance team. Data residency discussion to confirm US-only storage.
Quote from CTO (Mar 3 call): 'We need predictable tail latency — if Dedicated gives us consistent <100ms for top-k, we can move forward with a 12-month commit.'
Procurement: finance preparing preliminary spend approval; legal has initial questions about data processing addendum and subprocessor list.
Technical notes: existing infra on GCP; prefers VPC peering for Dedicated; currently using Postgres + S3 for store; needs connector guidance for nightly batch pipeline (Airflow).
Requested deliverables: Dedicated sizing recommendation, pricing sheet for 12/24 month commits, demo of fallback routing & cache behavior under simulated load.
Preferred POC timeline: 4 weeks for hosted baseline -> 6 weeks for Dedicated stress test -> decision window 2 weeks after benchmarks.
